messages.author: fd8c1a6a92804506
messages.subject: Can I not use shinyapps.io from a Windows OS? Or is it only the libraries that would have to be linux compatible? I am new to this.
parts: I had posted a question earlier about my first shiny app not being deployed on shinyapps.io. my google search leads me to believe I cannot use shinyapps.io because I have a windows OS? Is this true

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Can I not use shinyapps.io from a Windows OS? Or is it only the libraries that would have to be linux compatible? I am new to this.
parts:
Ravi,

shinyapps.io runs on Linux, which means the code you write and the packages you use must be compatible with Linux. Most, but not all R packages are. This also means you can not use any Windows specific calls or utilities.

That said, this does NOT mean you can't develop your application on Windows, and then deploy it to shinyapps.io. It simply means the code must be written in a compatible cross platform.

Hope that helps,
-Andy
